item.text: I’ll first inspect the current folder, then build the four page views as a single responsive, no-build app with shared sample course data and registration state.
The page layouts and shared course data are in place. I’m checking the JavaScript wiring now, especially catalog filters and registration updates, then I’ll fix any issues I find.

function bind(){document.querySelector('.mobile-menu')?.addEventListener('click',()=>document.querySelector('.navlinks').classList.toggle('open'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-add]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const list=getRegistered();if(!list.includes(b.dataset.add)){list.push(b.dataset.add);saveRegistered(list);rerender()}}));document.querySelectorAll('[data-remove]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{saveRegistered(getRegistered().filter(id=>id!==b.dataset.remove));rerender()}));document.querySelectorAll(['#search','#dept','#credits']).forEach(el=>el.addEventListener(el.id==='search'?'input':'change',filterCourses));document.getElementById('register-form')?.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('show')});document.getElementById('close-modal')?.addEventListener('click',()=>document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('show'));document.getElementById('modal')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='modal')e.currentTarget.classList.remove('show')})}

item.text:
Built the four-page responsive course registration app. The Home, Course Catalog, Registration, and Student Profile pages are linked through the navigation bar. The catalog has 12 sample courses, search and filters; course selections persist in local storage and appear in the registration and profile tables.

Files: [index.html](/work/index.html), [catalog.html](/work/catalog.html), [registration.html](/work/registration.html), [profile.html](/work/profile.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), [app.js](/work/app.js).

`node --check app.js` passed. I couldn’t verify browser console behavior in this environment.
